metadata.description: Core SKILL language functions (sklangref) available in all tools and versions

documentation.summary: Prints formatted output to the current output port

parameters.name: format_string
parameters.description: Format string with % placeholders (%s, %d, %f, %L, etc.)

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments to substitute in format string

documentation.return_value: Returns the formatted string
documentation.notes: Uses C-style format specifiers. %L prints SKILL objects in readable form.

documentation.summary: Returns the first element of a list

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The list to get the first element from

documentation.return_value: The first element of the list, or nil if list is empty
documentation.notes: Returns nil for empty lists. Part of fundamental list operations.

documentation.summary: Returns all elements of a list except the first

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The list to get the tail from

documentation.return_value: A list containing all elements except the first, or nil if input is empty
documentation.notes: Returns nil for single-element or empty lists.

documentation.summary: Constructs a new list by adding element to the front of list

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: The element to add to the front of the list

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The list to add the element to

documentation.return_value: A new list with element as the first item
documentation.notes: Fundamental list construction function. Does not modify the original list.

documentation.summary: Concatenates multiple lists into a single list

parameters.name: list1
parameters.description: The first list to concatenate

parameters.name: list2
parameters.description: Additional lists to concatenate

documentation.return_value: A new list containing all elements from the input lists
documentation.notes: Creates a new list without modifying the original lists.

documentation.summary: Returns the number of elements in a list

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The list to count elements in

documentation.return_value: An integer representing the number of elements
documentation.notes: Returns 0 for nil (empty list).

documentation.summary: Returns a new list with elements in reverse order

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The list to reverse

documentation.return_value: A new list with elements in reverse order
documentation.notes: Creates a new list without modifying the original.

documentation.summary: Concatenates multiple strings into a single string

parameters.name: string1
parameters.description: The first string to concatenate

parameters.name: string2
parameters.description: Additional strings to concatenate

documentation.return_value: A new string containing all input strings concatenated
documentation.notes: Creates a new string without modifying the original strings.

documentation.summary: Extracts a substring from a string

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The source string

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Starting position (1-based index)

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of characters to extract (default: to end of string)

documentation.return_value: A substring of the original string
documentation.notes: Uses 1-based indexing. Returns empty string if start is beyond string length.

documentation.summary: Returns a formatted string without printing it

parameters.name: format_string
parameters.description: Format string with % placeholders

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments to substitute in format string

documentation.return_value: The formatted string
documentation.notes: Similar to printf but returns string instead of printing it.

documentation.summary: Adds all numeric arguments together

parameters.name: numbers
parameters.description: One or more numbers to add (returns 0 if no arguments)

documentation.return_value: The sum of all arguments, or 0 if no arguments
documentation.notes: Can handle both integers and floating-point numbers.

documentation.summary: Subtracts subsequent numbers from the first number

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The number to subtract from

parameters.name: numbers
parameters.description: Numbers to subtract from the first number

documentation.return_value: The result of the subtraction
documentation.notes: With one argument, returns the number unchanged.

documentation.summary: Multiplies all numeric arguments together

parameters.name: numbers
parameters.description: One or more numbers to multiply (returns 1 if no arguments)

documentation.return_value: The product of all arguments, or 1 if no arguments
documentation.notes: Can handle both integers and floating-point numbers.

documentation.summary: Divides the first number by subsequent numbers

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The dividend

parameters.name: numbers
parameters.description: The divisors

documentation.return_value: The result of the division
documentation.notes: Division by zero causes an error.

documentation.summary: Conditional evaluation - executes then_expr if condition is true

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate for truth (nil is false, everything else is true)

parameters.name: then_expr
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate if condition is true

parameters.name: else_expr
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate if condition is false

documentation.return_value: Value of then_expr if condition is true, else_expr if false, nil if no else_expr
documentation.notes: Only nil is considered false; all other values are true.

documentation.summary: Executes expressions sequentially if condition is true

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate for truth

parameters.name: expressions
parameters.description: One or more expressions to evaluate if condition is true

documentation.return_value: Value of the last expression if condition is true, nil otherwise
documentation.notes: Useful for executing multiple statements conditionally.

documentation.summary: Executes expressions sequentially if condition is false

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate for truth

parameters.name: expressions
parameters.description: One or more expressions to evaluate if condition is false

documentation.return_value: Value of the last expression if condition is false, nil otherwise
documentation.notes: Opposite of when - executes when condition is false.

documentation.summary: Creates local variable bindings and evaluates expressions in that context

parameters.name: bindings
parameters.description: List of variable binding pairs (var value)

parameters.name: expressions
parameters.description: One or more expressions to evaluate with the bindings

documentation.return_value: Value of the last expression
documentation.notes: Variables are bound simultaneously, cannot reference each other.

documentation.summary: Iterates over a list, binding each element to var and evaluating expressions

parameters.name: var
parameters.description: Variable name to bind each list element to

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: List to iterate over

parameters.name: expressions
parameters.description: Expressions to evaluate for each element

documentation.return_value: Value of the last expression from the final iteration
documentation.notes: Variable binding is local to the foreach loop.

documentation.summary: Applies function to corresponding elements of lists, returns list of results

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Function to apply to each set of elements

parameters.name: lists
parameters.description: One or more lists to process

documentation.return_value: List containing results of applying function to each element set
examples: mapcar('car '((a b) (c d) (e f))) ; Returns (a c e)
documentation.notes: Stops when the shortest list is exhausted.

documentation.summary: Tests if element is a member of list, returns tail starting with element or nil

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Element to search for in the list

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: List to search in

documentation.return_value: Tail of list starting with element if found, nil otherwise
examples: member('b '(a b c d)) ; Returns (b c d)
documentation.notes: Uses equal for comparison, not eq.

documentation.summary: Searches association list for key, returns the key-value pair or nil

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key to search for

parameters.name: alist
parameters.description: Association list of (key value) pairs

documentation.return_value: The (key value) pair if found, nil otherwise
documentation.notes: Uses equal for key comparison.

documentation.summary: Tests if two objects are structurally equal

parameters.name: obj1
parameters.description: First object to compare

parameters.name: obj2
parameters.description: Second object to compare

documentation.return_value: t if objects are equal, nil otherwise
documentation.notes: Compares structure and content, unlike eq which compares identity.

documentation.summary: Loads and evaluates expressions from a SKILL file

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Path to the SKILL file to load

documentation.return_value: t if file loaded successfully, nil otherwise
documentation.notes: File is evaluated in the current context. Use full paths for reliability.
